context.name: Improvisation Capstone
context.oracleText:
Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile cards with total mana value 4 or greater. You may cast any number of spells from among them without paying their mana costs.
Paradigm (Then exile this spell. After you first resolve a spell with this name, you may cast a copy of it from exile without paying its mana cost at the beginning of each of your first main phases.)

source.text: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile cards with total mana value 4 or greater. You may cast any number of spells from among them without paying their mana costs.
Paradigm (Then exile this spell. After you first resolve a spell with this name, you may cast a copy of it from exile without paying its mana cost at the beginning of each of your first main phases.)

reviewNotes: The top-card loop stops when the accumulated mana value reaches four or the library is empty.
Eligible spells are cast during this resolution; type-based timing restrictions are ignored, but mandatory additional costs remain payable.
Paradigm is a named engine composition that exiles the resolving spell and creates its persistent first-main-phase delayed trigger.
